sections.heading: Disaster management — the paradigm and the machinery

blocks.text: The field's great shift: from **relief-centric response** to **risk-reduction across the cycle** — mitigation → preparedness → response → recovery ('build back better'). India's legal spine: the **Disaster Management Act 2005** — **NDMA** (PM-chaired) / SDMAs (CM-chaired) / DDMAs (Collector-chaired), **NDRF** (16 battalions; the world's largest dedicated force), NIDM, and the funds ladder (**NDRF/SDRF; the 15th FC's re-architecture: mitigation funds (NDMF/SDMF) alongside response — ~₹1.6 lakh crore window**). Policy stack: National Policy 2009, **NDMP 2016 (revised 2019** — the first national plan aligned to **Sendai 2015-30's** four priorities & targets), the **PM's 10-point agenda**, and India's global exports — **CDRI (2019)** and heat-action/EWS diplomacy.

rows: **Mitigation**
Hazard mapping-zoning, building codes, ecosystem buffers (mangroves cut surge — Coringa's proof), embankments-with-ecology
Cyclone shelters network (from 1977's lesson), coastal shelterbelts & mangrove restoration; Polavaram-era flood-cushion debates
**Preparedness**
Early-warning chains (IMD's doppler-satellite net; **Common Alerting Protocol/SACHET SMS**), mock drills, community task forces (Aapda Mitra), pre-positioning
**RTGS-era real-time monitoring; secretariat-volunteer last-mile warning**; fishermen-return protocols; the drill culture behind zero-casualty
**Response**
Incident Response System, NDRF-SDRF-forces triage, surge evacuation
**Mass evacuations** (Hudhud ~4 lakh era; Michaung lakhs moved); Vizag's urban response test 2014
**Recovery**
Build-back-better housing, livelihood restoration, PDNA (post-disaster needs assessment)
Post-Hudhud Vizag rebuild (~₹22,000 cr damage; smart-city convergence); Titli's Srikakulam horticulture recovery lessons

sections.heading: Impact assessment — and the evaluation frontier

items: **Impact assessment's toolkit**: rapid damage assessment (satellite + drone), **PDNA** (sectoral losses: housing-infra-livelihood-ecology), economic accounting (direct vs indirect vs macro losses — disasters cost India ~$10-15 bn/yr era estimates), and **HRVA (hazard-risk-vulnerability atlases)** feeding zoning; plus **EIA's disaster lens** — siting norms (CRZ for coasts) as ex-ante impact assessment.

**What works (evidence)**: early warning + evacuation = the mortality collapse (1977's 10,000 → Phailin/Hudhud's double digits → Michaung's near-zero); mangroves' surge attenuation (post-2004 tsunami studies); cash-based recovery beating material dole; **female task-force inclusion** improving compliance.

**Gaps (the honest audit)**: DDMA capacity (collector-overload), mitigation-fund under-use vs response bias, **urban flood governance** (Budameru 2024 — drainage encroachment as the unaddressed 'disaster before the disaster'), heat-action plans' patchiness, recovery's long-tail neglect (livelihoods after headlines), and climate-era compound risks outrunning static plans.

**Reform agenda**: risk-informed land use enforced, mitigation-fund pipelines, urban-drain audits, heat as notified disaster debate, parametric insurance (state-level cat-bonds thinking), and community-first (Sendai's 'all-of-society') — AP's volunteer capillaries as the national model for the last mile.

prelimsPointers: **DM Act 2005**: NDMA (PM chair), SDMA (CM), DDMA (Collector); **NDRF — 16 battalions**; NIDM for capacity.
**Sendai Framework 2015-30**: four priorities, seven targets (successor to Hyogo 2005-15).
**NDMP 2016 (revised 2019)** — first national plan on Sendai lines; **PM's 10-point agenda (2016 AMCDRR)**.
**15th FC** created **mitigation funds (NDMF/SDMF)** beside response funds — total disaster window ~₹1.6 lakh crore (2021-26).
**CDRI (2019)** — India-initiated Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure; **CAP/SACHET** — the national alert system.
**Aapda Mitra** — trained community volunteers scheme; IRS = Incident Response System.
AP's cyclone-mortality arc: **1977 (~10,000) → Hudhud 2014 (double digits) → Michaung 2023 (near-zero)** — the doctrine's proof.
**PDNA** = post-disaster needs assessment — the recovery-planning instrument.
mainsAngles: From relief to risk — trace the paradigm shift and India's DM Act architecture.

Response is funded, mitigation is filed — critique India's disaster-finance bias and the 15th FC's corrective.

The next disasters are urban, hot and compound — audit preparedness beyond the cyclone success story.

glossary.definition: The mitigation-preparedness-response-recovery loop — governance across risk's whole life, not just its eruption.
The 2015-30 global DRR compact — four priorities and seven targets from understanding risk to building back better.
The detection-decision-dissemination-response chain whose last mile determines lives saved.
Recovery that upgrades resilience (housing, siting, livelihoods) rather than restoring vulnerability.
Ex-ante risk-reduction financing (NDMF/SDMF) — the 15th FC's structural correction to response bias.
Payouts triggered by hazard parameters (wind speed, rainfall) rather than assessed loss — speed for certainty trade.

rows: **Air**
**PM2.5/PM10** (combustion, dust), SO2-NOx (power, vehicles), CO, **ground-level ozone** (secondary), benzene; stubble-episodic north; India hosts most of the world's most-polluted cities lists

**NAAQS (2009, 12 pollutants — under revision)**; **AQI (2015, 6 bands)**; **NCAP 2019** (~130 cities; 40% PM cut by 2026 vs 2017); CAQM for the NCR airshed; BS-VI leap (2020); PUSA-decomposer & paddy-shift for stubble
**Water**

Sewage (~72% urban untreated-gap era; CPCB's **polluted river stretches ~311/603**), industrial effluents (CETPs' patchiness), agrochemical runoff (nitrate-fluoride-arsenic groundwater), plastics; **eutrophication** (the Kolleru textbook case)
Water Act 1974 (CPCB/SPCBs); **Namami Gange** (~₹40,000 cr programme; STP capacity build); Jal Jeevan's quality testing; groundwater regulation (CGWA)
**Soil & waste**
Heavy metals, pesticide residues (POPs), **legacy dumpsites (~3,000+ lakh tonnes)**, e-waste (~16+ lakh t/yr, world #3), plastic (~40 lakh t/yr, ~single-use ban 2022), biomedical, C&D
**SWM Rules 2016 family** (segregation-EPR regimes: plastic-e-waste-battery EPR), **SBM 2.0's** dumpsite remediation & GFC star ratings; soil-health via fertiliser reform (nano-urea, PM-PRANAM)
**Noise & emerging**
Traffic-construction-festival noise (Noise Rules 2000: 55/45 dB residential day/night); light pollution; microplastics; PFAS 'forever chemicals'; AMR as pollution's biological edge
Rules enforcement + the frontier debate — cite one emerging pollutant to show currency

sections.heading: Management — principles, tools, the AP file

items: **Legal-doctrinal base**: Environment (Protection) Act 1986 (the umbrella post-Bhopal), Air Act 1981, Water Act 1974, **Art 21's right to a clean environment (Subhash Kumar 1991)**, polluter-pays & precaution (**Vellore 1996**), absolute liability (**M.C. Mehta-Oleum 1987**), public trust (Kamal Nath 1997), and the **NGT (2010)** as the enforcement accelerator (compensation regimes on drains, dumps, groundwater).

**Instrument spectrum**: command-control (standards, consents, closures) → market (coal cess history, **the CPCB-style emissions trading pilots — Surat's PM-ETS, the world's first particulate market**; the **carbon-market (CCTS) rollout**) → disclosure (star-rating, PARIVESH single-window with its dilution debates) → behavioural (LiFE, segregation campaigns) — the modern mix argument: standards set floors, markets find cheap abatement, courts backstop.

**The AP pollution file**: **Visakhapatnam's industrial airshed** (pharma-steel-port cluster; the **LG Polymers styrene leak, May 2020** — 12 deaths: AP's Bhopal-echo and NGT's ₹50-crore interim liability case), **Kolleru lake's** aquaculture eutrophication and the Operation Kolleru restoration (2006 demolitions; ongoing encroachment relapse), **Godavari-Krishna delta agrochemical loads**, fluoride belts (Prakasam-Guntur groundwater), granite-quarry dust (Rayalaseema), and coastal plastic on the aqua economy — each pairs a livelihood with its externality: the state's management test is **greening without de-industrialising**.

**Way forward**: airshed (not city) management, sewage-first water strategy, EPR enforcement with recycler formalisation, continuous-monitoring transparency, health-based standard revision (WHO 2021 guidelines vs NAAQS gap), and pollution as a **public-health budget line** — the reframing that ends strong answers.

prelimsPointers: **NCAP (2019)**: ~130 non-attainment cities; target **40% PM reduction by 2025-26** (base 2017); **AQI launched 2015** (six categories).
**BS-VI nationwide from 1 April 2020** — the leapfrog from BS-IV.
CPCB identified **~311 polluted river stretches** on 279 rivers (2022 assessment).
**Absolute liability — M.C. Mehta (Oleum, 1987)**; **polluter pays & precaution — Vellore (1996)**; right to clean environment — **Subhash Kumar (1991)**.
**LG Polymers styrene leak, Visakhapatnam — 7 May 2020**; NGT's ₹50-crore interim deposit; the absolute-liability revival case.
**Kolleru** — Ramsar wetland (2002); **Operation Kolleru (2006)** demolished fish-tank encroachments; relapse remains the issue.
**Surat's particulate emissions-trading scheme** — the world's first PM market; India's **CCTS** carbon market notified 2023.
**Single-use plastic ban (1 July 2022)**; EPR regimes cover plastic, e-waste, batteries, tyres.
Noise standards: **55 dB day / 45 dB night** (residential) under the 2000 Rules.

glossary.definition: Fine particulates under 2.5 microns penetrating deep into lungs and blood — the deadliest routine pollutant.
Nutrient-overload of water bodies driving algal blooms and oxygen crashes — Kolleru's aquaculture syndrome.
The Mehta-Oleum doctrine: hazardous enterprises owe full compensation without exceptions — stricter than strict liability.
Producers' statutory obligation for their products' end-of-life management — the waste-rules' economic engine.
Governing pollution across a meteorologically connected region rather than city borders — the CAQM model's logic.
A city persistently violating NAAQS — the NCAP's unit of mission.
